objectives.objective: Replace placeholder Privacy and Terms pages with structured, versioned, counsel-review-ready public legal content without inventing compliance claims.
objectives.evidence: Added packages/domain/src/legal content and rendered /privacy and /terms from scripts/build-public-pages.ts.

objectives.objective: Enumerate current-system privacy data categories: signup, account, household, learner, class, progress, communications, support, provider event, payment/test-payment, security, and operational records.
objectives.evidence: privacyDataCategories in packages/domain/src/legal/content.ts contains all required categories and unit tests assert the required titles.

objectives.objective: Update Terms so they do not say accounts are never granted and do not claim live paid checkout without evidence.
objectives.evidence: Terms acknowledge owner, parent/guardian, and student accounts; payment language is limited to fixture/test-payment and non-live checkout truth.

objectives.objective: Add structured Communication and Reminder Consent content.
objectives.evidence: communicationConsentNotice is rendered on /privacy and /terms and linked from signup consent copy.

objectives.objective: Add structured Parent/Guardian and Student Data Notice content.
objectives.evidence: parentGuardianStudentDataNotice is rendered on /privacy and covered by public legal E2E checks.

objectives.objective: Improve signup consent to be channel-specific, non-preselected, and separated between required service communications and optional reminders.
objectives.evidence: Signup now uses explicit email and WhatsApp reminder checkboxes, no optional reminder is selected by default, required service communications are described separately, and client payload mapping derives reminder_preference from explicit selections.

objectives.objective: Make suppression, STOP, unsubscribe, policy version, and consent timestamp handling clear.
objectives.evidence: Signup and legal copy describe unsubscribe/STOP/contact handling; form carries data-consent-policy-version and existing lead capture tests confirm consent version and consent timestamp recording for opted-in submissions.

objectives.objective: Ensure the public form does not ask for student-sensitive data.
objectives.evidence: Signup page asks for guardian/contact and class-fit information only and warns not to submit student names, ages, medical information, private learner notes, or other student-sensitive details.

objectives.objective: Add keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, validation, and no-JavaScript checks.
objectives.evidence: Added/updated Playwright E2E and accessibility tests for public legal pages, signup keyboard consent toggling, WhatsApp phone validation, mobile overflow, no-JS fallback, and axe coverage.

objectives.objective: Preserve public/authenticated bundle separation and current brand constraints.
objectives.evidence: Changes are limited to legal domain content, public page generation, public-only client consent mapping, public styles, and public tests. npm run brand:check and bundle checks passed.

objectives.objective: Run focused tests, affected suites, and broader practical gates without weakening safety checks.
objectives.evidence: Focused unit, page build, client build, public E2E, public accessibility, affected integration/E2E/accessibility/performance, secret scan, lint, typecheck, unit, integration, build, brand, and bundle gates passed.

objectives.objective: Run the full unfiltered E2E/performance suites on an isolated non-default port.
objectives.evidence: Full isolated-port suites reached an OT-88 dependency: Zoom leakage checks hardcode http://127.0.0.1:3100 as the allowed local origin, so the same mocked requests on ports 3118/3124 were classified as external. The OT-88-specific fix belongs outside this lane.

objectives.objective: Define cancellation, refund, and live payment terms beyond test-payment/fixture truth.
objectives.evidence: Current capability evidence does not prove live paid checkout. Business/legal approval is needed before stronger cancellation, refund, payment authorization, or billing-policy language is published.

objectives.objective: Define jurisdiction-specific privacy rights, retention periods, deletion windows, and legal compliance claims.
objectives.evidence: The lane intentionally avoids unsupported legal compliance and retention claims. Counsel/business approval is required before jurisdiction-specific rights or retention promises are added.

objectives.objective: Avoid deployments, production database access, external sends, provider mutations, and production configuration changes.
objectives.evidence: No deploy commands were run, no production database was accessed, no external messages/webhooks/payments/posts/invitations/helper requests were sent, no provider resources were mutated, and no production configuration was changed.
